<!--
  The full CV, and — apart from the section headings and the order they come in —
  nothing but a set of instructions for assembling one.

  Every name, date, appointment, paragraph and citation below is read at render time
  from ../_cv.yml (via {{< cv-header >}} and {{< cv >}}) and ../_publications.yml
  (via {{< pubs >}}). There is deliberately no fact about the person written in this
  file: edit the record, not the CV. cv/_metadata.yml carries the format wiring and
  cv/_typst-style.typ the whole design.

  This variant prints every entry flagged `in: [full]` at full depth: long
  descriptions, bullet lists, and the `references:` line where an entry has one.
-->
